kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتدل (form VIII)
# نَعْتَدِلُ (naʕtadilu) /naʕ.ta.di.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# نَعْتَدِلَ (naʕtadila) /naʕ.ta.di.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# نَعْتَدِلْ (naʕtadil) /naʕ.ta.dil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
